curateSection.heading: What makes us different

image1.alt: Mountain landscape with mist and valleys

curateSection.description: We’re proudly locally run, crafting adventures that helps you understand what the outdoors are all about. Our trips tread lightly on the planet, with well paid crew who share honest stories of history and culture shaped by the mountains. Experienced and first‑aid trained, they keep your journey safe while making it unforgettable. We support local communities with our sustainable responsible model of tourism which is very unique to the mountains.

features.title: We care about the planet
features.subtitle: Tread lightly on the environment.
features.body: We know that tourism is not always the most environmentally-friendly sector, and are on a mission to change that through our practices.

features.title: We care about truthful stories and authentic narratives
features.subtitle: Learn about regional history and local culture.
features.body: Our guides are affectionately known as "mountain nerds". You'll have opportunities to understand local history and culture and how it has been shaped by the mighty mountain landscape over millennia.
